State the purpose and scope in one paragraph. Name who the policy
applies to and what it covers.

# Policy statement

State the mandatory position in clear terms. Write each requirement
so a reader can test compliance.

# Responsibilities

Name who implements the policy, who enforces it, and who reports
on it.

# Compliance

State how the organisation monitors compliance and what happens on
breach.

# Review

State the review cycle and the owner of the next review.
